ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominating the central and lower regions, with 30% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels concentrated at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct high-intensity white contiguous blobs are mapped to the distal tips. The left lobe patch is a roughly triangular region with internal dark mottling. The right lobe patch is rectangular with prominent vertical dark striations. The central axial region is a solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 85 degrees; notch depth is significant relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations (peaks/valleys) along the entire trailing edge; amplitude of irregularities increases significantly at the outermost distal margins, particularly on the left lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve along the trailing edge leading to tapered, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark circular spots visible within the high-intensity white patches on both lobes; densest cluster is located on the lower-inner margin of the left distal patch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned dark vertical and diagonal linear disruptions are visible cutting through the white pigmentation on the right distal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical erosion and irregular jagged topography are present on the outer distal tips of both lobes, suggesting previous tissue loss or barnacle colonization sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Specular highlights from splashing water droplets create high-intensity noise and occlusion at the point where the peduncle meets the waterline.
